profile.summary: A company in Oakland, California that provides construction materials testing, special inspections and consulting services for buildings and infrastructure. Its services include laboratory testing, structural investigations, and code-required field inspection of structural materials during construction. It was founded in 1988.

review.notes: Company website shows the exact name, an Oakland address, and construction materials testing and special inspection services for DSA-permitted work, which fits OUSD's materials testing and special inspection master agreement. The summary, founding year (1988), phone, email and address are all shown on the cited pages; only generic business contacts are included.
